Package index

Episomal detection

Call focal amplicons that arose by simple episomal excision, and nominate the founder circularisation junction that bounds them.

call_simple_excision()
Call episomal extrachromosomal DNA from WGS structural variants
call_founder_boundary()
Nominate episomes by a VF-early circularisation DUP
detect_amplicon_seeds()
Detect focal-amplicon seeds from copy number alone

Mechanism callers

Standalone callers for the other routes to a focal amplification, each taking the same inputs and reporting that mechanism’s signature.

call_chromothripsis()
Call chromothripsis within (episomal) amplicons
call_chimeric_amplicon()
Call chimeric (cross-chromosome fusion) amplicons
call_bfb()
Call breakage-fusion-bridge (BFB) amplicons
call_brf()
Call breakage-replication/fusion (BRF) amplicons
call_translocation_bridge_amp()
Call translocation-bridge amplification (TBA) amplicons
call_chromoplexy()
Call chromoplexy (closed balanced rearrangement chains)
call_wgd()
Call whole-genome doubling (WGD) from allele-specific copy number

Visualisation

Plot the structural rearrangements underlying focal amplifications.

plot_sv_linear()
Linear copy-number and structural rearrangement plot
plot_sv_reconstruction()
Temporally-stratified rearrangement plot (SV+CN grouped by read support)
plot_sv_circos()
Whole-genome SV circos plot for one sample

Reading inputs

Turn copy-number and structural-variant calls from PURPLE/GRIDSS (or any other source) into the columns EpiTracer expects.

read_cnv()
Read and reformat copy-number segments for EpiTracer
read_sv()
Read and reformat structural variants for EpiTracer
read_purple_sv_vcf()
Convert a PURPLE / GRIDSS breakend VCF to BEDPE, keeping VF and JCN
prepare_amplicon_inputs()
Build EpiTracer caller inputs from copy-number and SV tables

Reference data and helpers

Bundled genome annotation and small shared utilities.

gene_locus()
Resolve gene symbol(s) to a plotting locus
load_centromeres()
Centromere regions for a bundled genome
load_chrom_lengths()
Chromosome lengths for a bundled genome
find_parallel_breakpoints()
Adjacent parallel breakpoints (breakage-replication/fusion hallmark)

Simulation

Generate ecDNA amplicons with known mechanisms — a circle at birth, after rounds of micronucleation and chromothripsis, or fused from two episomes — and render them as caller or plotter inputs.

sim_episome()
Simulate the birth of an episomal ecDNA
sim_replicate()
Simulate rounds of ecDNA amplification
sim_segregate()
Grow an ecDNA population by segregation and selection
sim_internal_deletion()
Simulate an internal deletion arising within an ecDNA
sim_micronucleation()
Simulate one round of micronucleation and chromothripsis
sim_reconfigure()
Reconfigure an ecDNA while preserving its founder junction
sim_shatter_to_episomes()
Simulate shattering into several new episomes
sim_fuse_episomes()
Simulate chimeric ecDNA formation by co-encapsulation of two episomes
sim_evolve()
Evolve a simulated ecDNA through several rounds
sim_cohort()
Simulate a cohort of ecDNA amplicons with known mechanisms
sim_benchmark()
Score EpiTracer's mechanism callers against simulated ground truth
sim_to_epitracer()
Render a simulated amplicon as EpiTracer caller inputs
sim_to_plot_inputs()
Render a simulated amplicon as plotter inputs
sim_noise()
Sequencing and calling noise for simulated amplicons
seed_locus()
A seed locus for simulation
ecdna_sim
Simulated ecDNA amplicon
summary(<ecdna_sim>)
Summarise a simulated amplicon

Example data

Small bundled datasets used in the vignettes and examples.

ex_caller_inputs
Example inputs for call_simple_excision()
ex_plot_inputs
Example inputs for plot_sv_linear()
ex_snv
Example small mutations with a kataegis cluster
ex_recon_inputs
Example inputs for plot_sv_reconstruction(): a complex CDK4 amplicon
